spec_quote_l246_250: 70% wiki/general (KO+EN, license-filtered, byte-encoded UTF-8) / 30% dialogue (KO+EN, ChatML byte-form OR anima-native emerge-trace)
rationale: interleave (PATH-B-2) effect is auto-recovered by train shuffle (DataLoader shuffle=True); concat is fast + reproducible + lower failure surface

wiki.selection_reason: largest single wiki source; lifted from corpus_v6 series matching spec drift'ed v4 lineage

dialogue.selection_reason: largest dialogue corpus; head -n 917598 = 30% of mix at 70/30 anchor
dialogue.content_sniff: Neurotransmitter Balance traces, [step N] Φ=X.XXXX → RATCHET, KO 안정/이완 labels — distinct from v6 wiki content despite shared Wikipedia tail

output.git_status: IGNORED (own 14: corpus >5MB → HF only, never anima git)

honest_c3.issue: PATH-B-1 concat: wiki block first then dialogue block. DataLoader shuffle=True at train time will mix; if shuffle disabled, dialogue starvation in early steps. Mitigation: confirm trainer shuffle=True on ubu1 launch.

v6_wiki + v8_dialogue share an identical Wikipedia footer (Wikidata: topic / Biomes ... travel guide from Wikivoyage). Some duplicate lines exist across wiki and dialogue blocks. Estimated overlap <0.1% (file tails only).

v8 dialogue content includes JP/ZH/KO mixed beyond spec's KO+EN target (commit dialogue corpus pre-existed multilingual). Mitigation: byte-level tokenizer absorbs all UTF-8; downside: slightly diluted KO+EN ratio inside the 30%.

wiki_lines=2141063 anchor uses all of v6 (no dedup, no license filter applied at this stage). Spec §3.3 says 'license-filtered' — this build inherits whatever filtering existed in upstream corpus_v6 generator; no additional pass.

70.00/30.00 line-ratio is exact, but BYTE ratio differs because dialogue lines avg ~17.7 bytes/line vs wiki ~50.9 bytes/line (some empty/trace lines). Byte-ratio actual: wiki=109.1MB / dialogue=45.7MB → 70.5%/29.5% by bytes. Acceptable drift; line-ratio anchor matches spec semantics (line ≈ training sample boundary).

build is NOT identical to AnimaLM v8 §2.2 'AL4-balance' source — that mix used different upstream corpora unavailable on this Mac. This is a v8-style approximation using anima ready/data sources. Reproduction parity ≠ AL4 byte-for-byte.
no shuffle within mix file. If ubu1 trainer disables DataLoader shuffle for any reason, training sees 2.14M wiki lines first, then 917K dialogue. C3-1 dependency.
